messages:
support-jen: FYI customer (Acme) reporting intermittent 504s from hosted inference, p95 tail latency spikes >13s, p99 ~28s. Request id: req_0x9eab. They say spikes align with high queue depth.
ops-bot: :warning: [ALERT] hosted-gateway queue depth > 95% for pool: hosted-prod-gpu-1 (alert: https://internal/alert/123)
oncall-jc: Looking. Is this the continuous-batching backlog we saw last month?
sre-mark: Pulling traces now — also seeing long dequeue times and batcher backlog. queue.depth metric: 312/320, dequeuer-latency p95=11s, dequeuer-latency p99=24s.
eng-runtime-lin: Can you paste the model id and a sample request? Want to check KV cache pressure and sequence lengths.
support-jen: Model: redwood/long-chat-30b-v1; customer provided this curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer tk...' -d '{"model":"redwood/long-chat-30b-v1","input":"<~2k tokens user prompt>"}'
```
support-jen: Root error they saw: gateway 504 after 30s, sometimes single-token completions succeed but complex queries tail out.
sre-mark: Pattern: when queue.depth > ~300 we get long gang-scheduling waits inside batcher. Batches become large and a few long requests hold KV caches, causing head-of-line tail latency.
eng-runtime-lin: Quick mitigation options: 1) reduce batch_window_ms for that pool (from 50->8ms) 2) throttle max_batch_tokens or enable short-circuit for single-request small-seq 3) add fallback model route for long requests. Which do we want immediately?
oncall-jc: We need fast mitigation. Option 1 + fallback seems safe. Can we hotpatch without full deploy?
sre-mark: I'll increase dequeue_threads from 8 -> 12 to drain faster, and roll batcher pods (no schema change). Starting rolling restart now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started rolling restart of batcher/hosted-prod-gpu-1 (12 pods) by sre-mark.
sre-mark: Restart completed on all pods. Applying runtime override: batch_window_ms=8 for pool hosted-prod-gpu-1.
eng-runtime-lin: Pushed runtime flag and enabled fallback routing: requests queued > 10s will route to redwood/long-chat-13b-v1. Also reduced max_batch_tokens for the 30b variant.
ops-bot: metric update: queue.depth dropped from 312 -> 60 within 2 mins; dequeuer-latency p95 down to 2.2s.
support-jen: Customer confirms 504s stopped for past 10 minutes and overall p95 dropped to ~2200ms, p99 ~5s. They've accepted the temporary measures.
customer-success-ana: Notifying customer, offering account credit for disruption. Will monitor and update.
sre-mark: Postmortem actions: add early warning alert at queue.depth 70% (currently 90%), add playbook steps: immediate batch_window reduction + fallback, and schedule load test to reproduce oscillation.
eng-runtime-lin: I'll draft RFC for adaptive batch window + dynamic dequeue scaling based on queue depth and sequence-length histograms.
oncall-jc: Closing incident after 2h monitoring window if metrics stay stable. Great job team :thumbsup:
